> Prospective G4 evidence correction (8 September 2026): apply the [v0.5 plan addendum](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/main/docs/governing/v0.5-g4-evidence-addendum.md). Target v0.5 and all lifecycle/disposition/profile obligations remain unchanged. Prior blocked evidence/comments remain historical; the seeded diagnostic is not relabeled all-real.

## Outcome and dependencies
Perform the separate **G4-V1 evidence review** after the V1-P4 implementation chain is complete:

```text
#20 / G3-V1 PASS
  → #21 abandonment / safe cessation / retirement
  → #22 fresh B1 replacement / no carryover
  → #23 normal disposition / complementary real-provider evidence
  → this G4-V1 review
```

**Depends on:** #21, #22 and #23, with #11 / G1-V1 PASS and #16 / G2-V1 PASS preserved as prerequisites. **Review status: NOT STARTED. G4-V1 verdict: NOT PASSED.** Creating or closing an implementation issue is not a gate pass.

This is review only. Do not implement/remediate missing behavior or begin/create V1-P5 or later work here.

## Authority and evidence order
1. Current [target v0.5](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/8838d98696822d31f8bbf96633ac925c15541124/docs/governing/broodling-target-responsibility-boundary-design-v0.5.md), especially §§4–6, 8.4 and 10.
2. Current [implementation/dependency plan v0.5](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/8838d98696822d31f8bbf96633ac925c15541124/docs/governing/broodling-implementation-dependency-plan-v0.5.md), especially §5.6 and §7 / V1-P4 / G4-V1.
3. [G1-V1 PASS](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/8838d98696822d31f8bbf96633ac925c15541124/qualification/v1-p1/issue-11-g1-v1.md), especially [W5/W7](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/7931ac9acd70b8670dfcaa48c05982897766367d/qualification/v1-p1/issue-8-w1-w2-w5-w7.md) and [W6](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/259a64aa7c06602b6f0fd49fe6af064097211046/qualification/v1-p1/issue-10-w4-w6.md).
4. Current V1-P2/P3 product implementation, inspected for backlog creation at `8838d98696822d31f8bbf96633ac925c15541124`.
5. [G2-V1 PASS from #16](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/88894861a0ae30f42c8e5295ec7995e16cbcc0f3/qualification/v1-p2/issue-16-g2-v1.md).
6. [G3-V1 PASS from #20](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/8838d98696822d31f8bbf96633ac925c15541124/qualification/v1-p3/issue-20-g3-v1.md).
7. The completed #21–#23 implementation and newly retained product-level evidence.

Review one coherent reachable product configuration, not a collection of incompatible fixture positives. The plan addendum permits the explicitly scoped implementer-only diagnostic adapter; audit that difference rather than claiming identical executable configuration. Record the actual reviewed commit and exact graph/runtime, SDK/sidecar, provider, host/containment, schema and custody versions. Qualification mechanisms are reference evidence, not product implementations by their mere presence.

## G4-V1 acceptance criteria
- [ ] **Abandonment/currentness:** #21 durably and irreversibly removes A1 completion/reuse eligibility before stop/retirement. All relevant product entry points honor it; an empty current slot cannot bypass unresolved old safety. Contract/B1/ownership/correlation history remains immutable.
- [ ] **Supported cessation/containment:** stop during mutation and adjudication, controller loss and caller interruption use the supported runtime boundary. Old providers/children cannot interfere with a replacement or sibling Work Unit. Unknown cessation/containment blocks retirement/replacement; a terminal label alone does not manufacture a stronger safety guarantee.
- [ ] **Safe owned retirement:** only A1's exact disposable worktree/owned local scaffolding is retired after safety. Provisioning/retirement races and lost acknowledgements cannot recreate A1, delete another tree/shared repository state or remove retained justification.
- [ ] **Fresh B1 replacement:** #22 creates a new Attempt/worktree/branch/submission/run under the same immutable Contract and original admitted B1/material. Live HEAD/issue drift and missing B1 never cause silent fallback. Duplicate ingress remains distinct from explicit retry; identical concurrent retries yield one replacement.
- [ ] **Zero carryover:** actual replacement bytes, graph bindings and relevant automatic provider context exclude old candidate changes, evidence, directives, semantic decisions, review/validation results, acceptance, summaries, caches and session history. Frozen Contract/B1 remains available. Diagnostic history supplies no replacement authority.
- [ ] **Late-result and stale-request isolation:** old submit acknowledgements, authority/final results and delayed stop/retry/provision/capture requests cannot resurrect A1, create an unintended further Attempt or influence A2. Ambiguously dispatched old work stays blocking until its existing identity/cessation is safely resolved without starting new coding work merely to stop it.
- [ ] **Normal final disposition:** #23 consumes current P3 final SemanticAcceptance and complete retained candidate/evidence/rationale for the last structural candidate generation. Only the admitted Contract's explicitly empty required-effect set is used. Runtime success, clean review/adjudication, lookalikes, stale authority, missing material or unresolved semantic obligations cannot yield `SUCCEEDED`.
- [ ] **Crash/race/idempotency:** retained controls cover abandonment commit, stop/terminal observation, retirement, replacement allocation/provisioning, submit acceptance before run-ID persistence, P3 capture and disposition commit/acknowledgement. Stop/retry/finalize races preserve one authority and one justified result. Preserve P2's rule that B1 is checked before first dispatch, not after valid graph-authorized mutation.
- [ ] **Interrupted finalization:** after final runtime output, including after complete P3 custody but before disposition, restart yields an already complete durable disposition or wholesale abandonment. There is no promotion of partial/pre-disposition history into success, completed-occurrence scanning, semantic catch-up or late eligibility restoration. A committed complete disposition remains readable after caller/session loss and controlled disposable cleanup without rerunning software work.
- [ ] **Real-provider no-effect evidence:** Apply the current plan addendum: either a single all-real integrated repair run or all four complementary legs—an all-real normal product completion, a seeded actual downstream repair-to-disposition chain controlling only the no-op initial implementer, deterministic integrated repair/P4 fault controls, and explicit compatibility/provenance audit. Require genuine Contract-backed finding/directive/correction, renewed evidence, fresh review, eligible resolution, repaired final acceptance and retained disposition in the repair chain. Verify transparent downstream delegation under unchanged qualified provider/containment settings; the diagnostic shim is a disclosed test adapter, not an all-real qualified executable. No fabricated downstream response, post-admission tampering, incompatible profile positives or cross-Attempt semantic composition. Historical blocked records remain unchanged. No single clean-only or controlled-repair witness suffices. This is finite G4 integration assurance, not P5 semantic evaluation.
- [ ] **Compatible reuse and scope:** W5/W6/W7 and current P2/P3 mechanisms are reused without a new lifecycle engine. Material changes to profile assumptions have affected controls explicitly rerun and recorded. No effects/GitDelivery/publication/reconciliation, candidate sealing/provenance, cross-Attempt semantic reuse, scheduler, session manager, generic second validator/router or runtime ledger has been introduced.
- [ ] **Preservation and verdict:** commit a new G4-V1 record with separate review status and gate verdict, immutable implementation/evidence links, expected/actual observations, controlled-versus-real distinctions and limitations. Preserve all prior qualification/gate records, including historical blocked verdicts, unchanged. Record **PASS only when every current G4 obligation is supported**; otherwise record BLOCKED/FAIL with the exact unmet case and its owner in #21–#23.

## Stop boundary
Missing, unexecuted or incompatible required evidence blocks G4; do not waive it, broaden V1 or remediate inside this review. G4 PASS would establish only this single-host no-effect lifecycle/disposition integration, not broad semantic reliability, effects readiness, distributed operation or release qualification.

Stop after recording the G4-V1 verdict. Do not create V1-P5/later backlog, product-interface work, semantic-evaluation campaigns or additional lifecycle architecture.
title: [Gate G4-V1] Review abandonment, fresh B1 retry and normal no-effect disposition
